_comment: INDEPENDENT CONTROL CORPUS. Hand-authored against the fifteen specs at d854a75.
Nothing here is produced by extractFacts(). This is the answer to the objection that
sampling a control from the extractor's own fixtures tests the matcher rather than the
extractor: if the extractor is blind to a class or a sentence form, no fixture exists and
no fixture-derived control can expose it. Each entry mutates the DOCUMENT in memory and
asserts the miss count rises. A control that does not fire fails the run.
'mutation' is applied to docs/STRATEGY.md before auditing. 'kind' records what the
mutation breaks, so a failure names the blind spot rather than just a number.
The first six are Agent SOL's adversarial mutations, kept verbatim in intent.

controls.name: swap scout and archer hit points wherever the row appears
invert the bloom/outline prohibition
controls.find: Do not make bloom responsible for outlines

controls.name: invert weather/day-night ordering wherever it is stated

mutations.find: Weather is applied **after** day/night every frame
only after the day/night colours are computed
mutations.replace: while the day/night colours are computed

mutations.find: is **shorter** than a soldier's 15 on purpose

controls.name: remove a storage key from its owning section
remove a shipped formula
controls.replace: the weather weights ease toward their target

controls.name: remove a negative control
controls.find: Do not create one light per beam

controls.name: remove an accessibility rule
controls.find: FOV never encodes required gameplay information
